explanation: I searched Mathlib (commit 83abb3e776bd) for statements about module-finiteness of MvPolynomial under the algebra structure induced by `MvPolynomial.rename f` (i.e. `(rename f).toRingHom.toAlgebra` / `Algebra.toModule`). Searched all of Algebra/MvPolynomial and RingTheory/Polynomial for `Module.Finite`, `Finiteness`, `Algebra.Finite`, `rename`+finiteness, `Algebra.toModule`, `toRingHom.toAlgebra`; also grepped for `not_finite`/`Polynomial.not_finite` and for shapes like `Function.Surjective f ∨ Subsingleton R`. The only MvPolynomial finiteness results in Mathlib are `Module.Finite R (MvPolynomial ι R)` for `IsEmpty ι`, `MvPolynomial.finite_universalFactorizationMap`, and the (co)finiteness of `MvPolynomial` over itself via a basis; none characterizes finiteness of `MvPolynomial τ R` as a module over `MvPolynomial σ R` via `rename` in terms of surjectivity of `f` or `Subsingleton R`. Mathlib only supplies the ingredients used in the proof (`MvPolynomial.rename_surjective`, `Module.Finite.of_surjective`, `Polynomial.not_finite`), which do not amount to a single matching declaration.
